title: Higher-degree component of dense-open cohomology comparison
statement: For the data of lem-pbc-s2-dense-open-high-cohomology, the counit map on underlying abelian sheaves induces bijections on H^q for every q > 1.

proof.text: Choose the canonical closed complement i:Z→X of U. Apply shortExact_openClosedShortComplex to the module sheaf F and shortExact_map_forget₂ to obtain the short exact abelian sequence S. Its first arrow is definitionally the specified underlying counit ε.

Apply exists_dense_irreducible_opens inside U. Its union W is contained in U and dim(X minus W)≤0. The closed immersion Z→X factors topologically as an inducing map into X minus W, since its range is X minus U. IsInducing.topologicalKrullDim_le bounds dim Z by dim(X minus W), hence dim Z≤0. No irreducibility or nonemptiness assumption on X or U is introduced.

For the underlying abelian sheaf B of i^*F, zero_dimensional_etale_cohomology over k gives positive-degree derived cohomology vanishing. Apply nonempty_sheafH_extDerivedIso to transport this to Subsingleton(Sheaf.H B n). The map i is finite, so bijective_edgeMap_of_isFinite identifies this cohomology with that of i_* B. Forgetting coefficients commutes definitionally with lowerStar; therefore this is precisely the positive cohomology of the third term of S.

For q>1, write q=m+1 with m>0. Both H^m(S.X₃) and H^(m+1)(S.X₃) are subsingleton by the previous step. The proved source-library lemma Sheaf.H.bijective_map_f, which is the two adjacent exactness statements of the long exact sequence, gives Function.Bijective(Sheaf.H.map S.f (m+1)). S.f is definitionally ε, giving exactly the original conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem dense_open_high_cohomology_high (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    let ε := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U.ι).counit.app F)
    ∀ q : ℕ, 1 < q → Function.Bijective (Sheaf.H.map ε q)
